name: Nee x Nee! Docchi ga Suki? Docchi mo!! ~Yasashii Onee-chan to Cool na Onee-chan ni Hasamarete Boku wa Mou!!~
original_name: 姉×姉！どっちが好き？どっちも！！ ～優しいお姉ちゃんとクールなお姉ちゃんに挟まれて僕はもうっ！！～
source:
The protagonist’s two older sisters—one acting as a mother figure, the other as a father figure—raised him with both kindness and discipline. Thanks to their efforts, he grew up to be a good kid who cares deeply about his family.

Though, perhaps they tried a little too hard…
Because now, the protagonist has grown to like his sisters just a bit more than family.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ011923.html/]dlsite[/url]]
